name: [🔥RELEASE] Immortal Luck
desc:
Welcome to Immortal Luck! 🔥

📜In the beginning, the world was chaos—a storm of raw energy. To tame it, the ancient gods forged the Wheel of Eternity, a divine artifact of chance. From its endless spins, radiant Auras were born—ethereal flames that hold the power to harness qi, the life force of the universe.

These Auras became the heart of cultivation, each representing fate’s blessing—or curse. But no one chooses their destiny. Each cultivator must spin the Wheel, gambling their future on its glow. From dim Common Flames to the legendary Prismatic Blaze, the strength of your Aura shapes your path. 

Will you spin the Wheel of Eternity? Fortune or ruin, glory or despair—your fate awaits!  🌠

⭐Join the group for rewards: https://www.roblox.com/communities/35177826/MS-Immortal-RNG

📢Join the community for updates/news!
